hero.title: Literature Triage Board
hero.description: Monitor recent systematic reviews, Meta-analysis papers, review protocols, and preprints from PubMed, Europe PMC, medRxiv, and arXiv, then review them as a screening list organized by topic match, recency, source signal, and abstract quality.
hero.selectProjectHint: Select a project in the sidebar first, then send papers into chat for analysis intake.

xiaohongshu.note: If you haven't installed xiaohongshu-cli yet, run: uv tool install xiaohongshu-cli

settings.browserCookieDescription: Read browser cookies from the machine hosting the MedHelp service. Make sure a browser on that machine is already logged into xiaohongshu.com.
settings.serviceMachineHint: This reads browser cookies from the machine running the MedHelp service, not from the device where this page is open. If you are using a remote deployment, prefer QR login.
settings.cookieSourceDescription: If auto-detection fails, choose the browser actually installed on the server machine.
settings.cookieFailure: Login failed. Make sure a browser on the server machine is logged into xiaohongshu.com.
settings.qrLoginDescription: Prefer this mode for remote deployments or Linux environments where browser-cookie extraction is less reliable.
settings.qrFailure: QR login failed. Please try again.
settings.qrRecommendedHint: This looks like a remote-access setup, so QR login is recommended by default because it does not depend on reading browser cookies from the host machine.
